# cubepath_ddos_asns (Data Source)

Searches the ASNs available for DDoS ASN filtering (asns of cubepath_ddos_protection_profile).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) An ASN number (exact match) or part of a network name. Omit it to list the whole catalog.

### Read-Only

- `asns` (Attributes List) Matching ASNs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--asns))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--asns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `asns`

Read-Only:

- `asn` (Number) AS number.
- `name` (String) Network name.
